action.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Read the file path from stdin context
CONTEXT=$(cat)
FILE_PATH=$(echo "$CONTEXT" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    print(data.get('file', ''))
except:
    print('')
" 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Only check .py files
if [[ "$FILE_PATH" != *.py ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Try flake8 first, then pycodestyle, then pep8
if command -v flake8 &>/dev/null; then
  RESULT=$(flake8 --max-line-length=79 --max-doc-length=72 "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1)
  TOOL="flake8"
elif command -v pycodestyle &>/dev/null; then
  RESULT=$(pycodestyle --max-line-length=79 "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1)
  TOOL="pycodestyle"
elif command -v pep8 &>/dev/null; then
  RESULT=$(pep8 --max-line-length=79 "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1)
  TOOL="pep8"
else
  echo "No PEP8 linter found (flake8, pycodestyle, or pep8). Install one to enable post-save linting."
  exit 0
fi

if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then
  echo "PEP8 violations found by $TOOL in $FILE_PATH:"
  echo "$RESULT"
else
  echo "PEP8 check passed for $FILE_PATH"
fi

exit 0
